anomalyDesc.message: Detects unusual viewer count spikes. Compares to past stream averages for new streams, or rate of change for ongoing ones. No alert without prior history.

anomalyNote.message: New stream (< 10 min): compares to past stream averages. Ongoing stream: checks rate of change. No alert without prior history.

anomalyPlateauTitle.description: Plateau detection notification title (suspicious bot-held viewer count).

anomalyPlateauBody.description: Plateau detection body. $1 = plateau duration in minutes, $2 = average viewer count.

anomalySmoothTitle.description: Smoothness detection notification title (suspicious linear bot growth).

anomalySmoothBody.description: Smoothness detection body. $1 = growth percent, $2 = window minutes, $3 = from value, $4 = to value.

appDescription.message: No more ninja streams at 3 AM — KickAlert catches every surprise broadcast, even the sneakiest ones ;)

autoUnmuteCheckbox.message:
Automatically unmute player after auto-launch
(Note: Not visually reflected in the volume slider)

chatBotFilterDesc.message: Hide bot messages. Click a chip to remove.

chatFavoriteDesc.message: Favorites' messages are highlighted with their own Kick color.

chatFilterModeDesc.message: Hide removes the message. Blur fades it — hover to see.

chatIntegrationDesc.message: When on, Chat tab appears above. After first install, refresh any open Kick tabs.

chatKeywordDesc.message: Messages containing these words are highlighted in green.

chatRepeatDesc.message: Hides when the same user sends the same message 3+ times.

chatTagDesc.message: Get notified when someone tags your username.

cloudSyncNote.message: Sync settings across devices via your browser account. Custom sounds and notification history are not synced.

customSoundLimitNote.message: Upload audio files up to $1 MB.

customSoundStatusErrorTooLarge.message: Error: File size $1 MB exceeds the limit

duplicateTabGuardButtonTooltip.message: Toggle duplicate tab guard when auto-launching. When on, a new tab will not be opened if a tab for the stream is already open.

fetchError.message: Failed to load channels. Please check that you are logged in to Kick and try again.

fetchErrorBlocked.message: Your connection has been temporarily blocked. Wait a few minutes or try a VPN.
fetchErrorBlocked.description: Popup error when API returns 403 (connection/IP block, e.g. Cloudflare bot detection). Distinct from fetchError which is for 401 (auth required).

langBrowserNoteUnsupported.message: Browser language not supported — using English

resetSuspendOnRestartCheckbox.message: Reset auto-launch settings to On when browser restarts

showOfflineChannels.message: Show offline channels in Following tab

soundModeExtensionTooltip.message: Eye-catching custom alerts — hard to miss

soundModeWindowsTooltip.message: Standard system sound — may blend into background

chatBroadcasterDesc.message: Get notified when the streamer writes in chat. Max 1 notification per minute.

chatWordFilterDesc.message: Messages containing these words are hidden or blurred.

chatUserFilterDesc.message: Messages from listed users are hidden or blurred.

chatEmojiSpamDesc.message: Dims messages with excessive emojis (hover to reveal).

anomalyAgeLabel.description: Anomaly notification body when API provides stream start_time. $1 = minutes live.

anomalyObsLabel.description: Anomaly notification body when API didn't provide stream start_time. $1 = minutes of observation.

anomalyWindowLabel.description: Anomaly notification — window over which the change happened. $1 = minutes.

botScoreTooltip.description: Tooltip on bot score badge in popup. $1 = score 0-100.

botTrackerSettings.description: Options section title for bot detection settings.

botScoreAlwaysVisibleLabel.message: Show bot score on all live channels
botScoreAlwaysVisibleLabel.description: Toggle label — show bot score badge on all live channels.

botScoreAlwaysVisibleHint.message: When off, the score appears only during a spike.
botScoreAlwaysVisibleHint.description: Hint text under the always-visible toggle.

botScoreFormulaInfo.message: Score = chat health vs expected by viewer count. Logarithmic baseline normalizes small/large channels.
botScoreFormulaInfo.description: Bot detection formula description in options panel.

chatChipRemoveTooltip.description: Tooltip shown on hover over a removable chip in chat panel.

viewerHistoryNoData.description: Shown in viewer history modal when stream has too little data

vhPeakAt.description: Viewer chart peak time x-axis label
